# secstream-bench: rules for Copilot

Goal: a benchmarkable streaming intrusion-detection system that answers "what does security cost a streaming ML pipeline?". The plan is in docs/SPEC.md.

## How to work
- Work on ONE phase at a time. Before editing, read the Overview, Stack, Data and Testing sections of docs/SPEC.md plus the phase you were asked for. Never start a later phase.
- Plan briefly, implement in small steps, run the relevant tests after each step, fix failures before moving on.
- A phase is done only when its acceptance checks in docs/SPEC.md pass. Then stop and report: files changed, commands run with results, what is NOT done, assumptions and deviations.
- Keep code simple. The owner must be able to explain every file: small functions, type hints, docstrings that say why, no clever metaprogramming.
- Log non-obvious decisions in docs/DECISIONS.md (decision, alternatives, reason). After each phase, add a plain-language file-by-file explanation to docs/WALKTHROUGH.md.

## Hard rules
- Free and local only: open-source tools, no paid APIs, no cloud services, no secrets in the repo.
- Target is Linux containers; the host needs only Docker and Git. Run and document commands as `docker compose run --rm dev make <target>`.
- Pin dependency and image versions. Do not invent package names, API calls, flags or dataset URLs. Check the official docs; if you cannot verify something, say so and note it in docs/DECISIONS.md.
- Never invent numbers. Every figure in README or docs must be generated by a script from files in results/. If something has not been measured, write "not yet measured". Label synthetic-data results as synthetic.
- Do not commit datasets, large model files, fuzzing queues or corpora. Commit only tiny samples and minimized regression inputs.
- Everything is an offline simulation on public data or this repo's own code. Send no traffic beyond localhost and do not target third-party software.
- Long jobs (full benchmark sweeps, fuzzing campaigns, full federated sweeps) are run by the owner via make targets. In agent sessions run only smoke-sized versions.
